'''Joey Dinigeas''' (also spelled '''Joey Dinigiea''' and '''Joey Dinigea''') is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[June 2001 Honolulu tournament]] on 2 June 2001 with tat. Mains and a Hidden mains variant, according to Donovan Lim's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2424">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-08-honolulu-hi-6-2-01d2424/ honolulu-hi-6-2-01], DeckTech (Donovan "topspinelite" Lim, 8 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-08-honolulu-hi-6-2-01d2424/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
